source.instrument: LeCroy WavePro 740Zi, 40 GS/s, 4 GHz, DC50, bandwidth limit off; C2 = detector output direct, C3 = after the ZFL-1000LN+ amplifier (simultaneous)
source.reduction: scripts/preamp/reduce_zfl.py (aligned on the amplified peak, 0.1 ns grid)

caveats: Measured single-ion events, stray ions with no mass information. Heights are as recorded at the two scope inputs, peak-positive; the scope was re-ranged during the run (C2 2 or 5 mV/div, C3 10-100 mV/div), so neither the noise floor nor the clipping ceiling is common to the set.
6 raw and 9 amplified captures touched an ADC rail (marked). Any pulse-height statistic must exclude them; clipping drops or shrinks the largest events, so even a masked spread is a lower bound.

No splitter or gain correction is applied. The x3 factor in the preamp notes was taken from the ZFRSC-123-S+ datasheet, but the splitter used was the ZFRSC-12B-S+, so absolute detector heights derived with it are uncertain.
Traces are aligned on the amplified peak and baseline-subtracted (median of the first 5 ns); widths are the amplified pulse's FWHM on the 0.1 ns grid.
